entry_conditions: Red is at or near the central buffer and blue is the intended object. Normal red-release entry is supported, but this package is preferred for a plausible later entry with blue elevated, co-moving, or near its destination.
exit_conditions: Blue is visibly stationary inside the observed blue goal, gripper open and TCP retreating; a later supervised exit is available after buffered red closure and initial lift.
overlap_role: All assigned actions remain supervised. The initial 210-230 action overlaps include final red release through complete blue approach/contact/lift; the terminal 230-240 action overlaps include blue placement/release and buffered-red approach/closure/lift.
successor_readiness: Use settled blue plus open/clear gripper as the robust place_red switch cue. If the tail is continued, switch only when buffered red visibly follows the closed gripper upward; do not use a close command alone.
failure_signatures: Blue not co-moving, descent offset from blue_goal, opening while blue is high, blue remaining attached after opening, red disturbance, or persistent IK residuals. Source displacement favors h01 and a modest noncanonical servo state favors h03.
continuation_guidance: Resolve the actual destination from each new causal replan and hold it fixed for one sampled chunk. Continue through supervised terminal overlap if needed, but stop rather than treating this package as drop or collision recovery.
limitations: The fixed-goal demonstrations do not measure shifted-goal success. There is no contact truth, and observed co-motion is only a routing cue. Goal-relative targets cannot guarantee source acquisition, collision avoidance, release, or reachability.
